notes: Packages exempted from pnpm's 24-hour `minimumReleaseAge` guard, each with the
reason it was exempted. Read by scripts/check-release-age-exemptions.py, which
package that is not here with a real reason.
POLICY, decided by the board owner 2026-09-10 (H17/#952): keep the 24h guard.
It exists for a too-FRESH dependency that turns out to be compromised or broken
and is unpublished within a day. `check:expo-compat` already tolerates a version
pnpm will not yet install (H15/#953) — it warns while every outdated target is
inside the window and fails the moment one is installable — so a same-day Expo
patch needs NO exemption at all. The bump lands the next day, untouched.
So this file is expected to stay empty. An entry here is a deliberate decision to
accept an unaged package, not a way to make a red check green: `expo install
--fix` writes the pnpm-workspace.yaml block silently, and the whole point of the
check is that it cannot also write a reason.
